messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the long‑weekend holidays that fell in Canada during 2023 (based on the federal statutory holidays and the most common provincial observances).  For each entry I’ve listed the date range that would give you a “long weekend” (Saturday‑Sunday‑weekday) and the holiday(s) that create it.  If you’re targeting a specific province, just pick the rows that apply to that province.

| Date Range | Holiday(s) | Province(s) that observe it | Notes |
|------------|------------|-----------------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) | All | No extra day; the holiday falls on a weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Monday) | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador | Most provinces observe Family Day on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Feb 11–13** | Family Day (Monday) | Quebec | Quebec observes Family Day on the 2nd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (Friday) | All | Good Friday is a statutory holiday on Friday. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Monday) | All | Victoria Day is always on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Saturday) – observed on Monday July 3 | All | When Canada Day falls on a weekend, the holiday is observed on the following Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Monday) | All | Labour Day is always on the first Monday of September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Monday) | All | Thanksgiving is always on the second Monday of October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (Saturday) – observed on Monday Nov 13 in some provinces | Some provinces (e.g., Ontario, British Columbia, Manitoba, Saskatchewan) observe Remembrance Day on the following Monday if it falls on a weekend. | Federal holiday only on Nov 11. |
| **Dec 23–26** | Christmas Day (Monday) + Boxing Day (Tuesday) | All | This gives a 4‑day stretch (Sat‑Tue). |

### Quick Summary

| Long‑Weekend | Key Holiday(s) | Typical Duration |
|--------------|----------------|------------------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 18 (most provinces) | Sat‑Mon |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Fri‑Sun |
| **Victoria Day** | May 20 | Sat‑Mon |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (observed Jul 3) | Sat‑Mon |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Sat‑Mon |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Sat‑Mon |
| **Christmas/Boxing** | Dec 25‑26 | Sat‑Tue |

Feel free to filter by province or add any additional provincial holidays you’re interested in. Happy planning!
